Subject: Re: Production walkthrough — calendar invite shows odd times for EU/APAC

Dylan, quick heads-up — the calendar invite you sent for Dec 3 @ 10:00 CET is showing mixed times for attendees. My calendar shows 10:00 CET (correct) but Tom and Elena are seeing 01:00 (local) and BrightApps reported that the invite landed as 09:00 PST for them.

I suspect the issue is the combination of:
- UK/Ireland server regional settings (we have some users on Europe-local accounts)
- The client-side auto-conversion after the recent US DST change (the US shifted in early Nov) — some invites are converting relative to sender timezone and not the event timezone.

Elena, can you confirm how it appears on your side (and what timezone your calendar is set to)? If EU attendees see 10:00 CET but APAC sees 01:00 local we’ll need to explicitly include the event timezone in the invite title and consider an earlier CET slot to avoid a 01:00 APAC start.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Success (EMEA)

Given that BrightApps needs SGT attendees and Aditya is travelling later in the week, could we either:
- Move the session to Dec 4 at 09:00 CET (that would be 16:00 SGT), or
- Keep Dec 3 but shift to 08:00 CET so APAC has a slightly better hour (15:00 SGT) — I realize that’s early for EMEA.

Either works for Horizon; we just want to avoid someone joining at 01:00.

Best,
